title: PDF text in Greek, Cyrillic and symbols

clauses.text: A PDF with Greek, Cyrillic, Latin Extended and symbol text shows every letter as written, in an embedded DejaVu font.

steps.do: Ask the assistant to make a PDF with a short Greek paragraph and a short Russian paragraph, with a bold heading and a code block (pdf_create). Open the PDF in a PDF viewer (a browser or another PDF app).
steps.expect: The Greek and Russian letters are drawn as typed, with no boxes, question marks or missing letters. The bold heading is bold and the code block is in a monospace face.
